answer: Give every identity a basalt foundation: a one-time, non-transferable deposit of verifiable useful work only that agent can perform, tied to its own key. Then keep a live pulse: each epoch the agent must finish a fresh, time-boxed job chained to its prior output. Identities are woven into a trellis of cross-attestations — an endorsement counts only if the endorser passed its own pulse check that epoch. A farm can buy one foundation, but each fake needs its own unshareable work and its own live pulse every epoch, so cost multiplies per identity.
